criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name the load-bearing claim and signal a correction with zero snark, within the ~210-char cutoff. AK stakes absent from those two lines keeps it from a 10.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Claim drives live 2026 Anchorage Assembly guardrails ordinance and Mat-Su incentive decisions. No dollar amount attached to the AK deals keeps it from a 10.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Paragraph 3 states the strongest honest version and validates skepticism for a rural economy before correcting. Matches dossier steelman. No snark.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: All rebuttal figures trace to Brookings/Bahar and Wright (BLS, 93 counties), is_primary true. Only one source carries all three points; a second outlet would reach 10.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named individuals, outlets, dates, numbers, and specific bodies appear at near-every-sentence density. Transition and bullet block slightly thinner.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Three independently originated named asserters plus a primary Brookings study, all in the dossier. Claim asserters are opinion pieces rather than primary documents.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, position-taking, structurally like post_001.md. 'Here is where the frame breaks' slightly more dramatized than the anchor's matter-of-fact pivots.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 424 words, 2691 chars, 2-4 sentence paragraphs, one 3-bullet single-clause block. Meets every descriptor-10 element.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closing question is real, debatable, tied to the corrected multiplier frame, addressed to a named constituency. No softener or CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader can name the Anchorage Assembly guardrails ordinance and Mat-Su incentive proposals as the proceedings to reframe with the multiplier analysis.

hard_fail_checks.steelman_present: PASS - paragraph 3 steelmans before the rebuttal

one_sentence_fix: Add a second independent credible source alongside Brookings to corroborate one of the three rebuttal figures, lifting counter-evidence toward a two-source standard.
